frame: tree-local: x east, y north, z up, cm; pivot at the trunk base. OBJ stores (x, y, z) as authored (the plateau_props.py convention); bounds_cm are Unreal-local (x, -y, z)

technique.branching: Weber & Penn, "Creation and Rendering of Realistic Trees", SIGGRAPH 1995 (the model of Blender's Sapling add-on; recursion written here because Sapling is not bundled)
technique.leaves: alpha-masked leaf cluster cards from an atlas (SpeedTree-style leaf cards), normals bent to the crown ellipsoid (SpeedTree leaf puffiness) and clamped from pointing down
technique.textures: Scripts/plateau_textures.py primitives: signed-distance serrated leaflets, Worley bark plates
technique.conifers: Weber & Penn shape 0 (conical) on one leader; limbs in whorls after the Branch Rings option of Blender's Sapling add-on (add_curve_sapling/utils.py); planar spruce laterals; needle-cluster cards on twigs and outer limbs; Wesslen and Seipel, "The Virtual Forest", SIGRAD 2004 (Weber & Penn for spruce and pine, health = leaf_retention)
technique.palmate: silver maple lobes joined over a central blade with Inigo Quilez's polynomial smooth minimum (iquilezles.org/articles/smin)
